GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 311.1 (12 Dec 45) AG
(SCAPIN - 429)
12 December 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : THE IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Re-establishment of Civilian Mail Service.
Reference C.L.O. No.566 (5), 14 November 1945, subject: "Opening of Communications For Japanese Nationals Overseas", the request that mail service be resumed between Japanese nationals and their families, residing in other countries, is not favorably considered at the present time.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
